nodes.title: Mass growth allowance by maturity
nodes.text: Growth added to each item's basic mass by how it was obtained: EST 20 %, CALC 10 %, DATASHEET 5 %, CAD 5 %, WEIGHED 1 %. An item may override. The pack carries 0 %: its listing spread is not growth but a bounding case, reported separately at 503 / 550 / 680 g (ASM-A3-PACK-RANGE).
nodes.basis: Maturity-based allowance after AIAA S-120A (mass properties control); percentages are A3's choice for a student foam build, ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Pack fore-aft trim travel from its nominal station
nodes.text: Printed U-spacers behind the pack (0-22 mm in 2 mm steps, POD-008); the nominal 550 g pack flies the 8 mm spacer, so the pack can go 8 mm aft (no spacer) or up to 14 mm forward (22 mm of spacers), the forward travel further limited by the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK)

nodes.title: Pack mass range from listings
Length from the pod nose to the most forward pack fore face
nodes.text: Pod nose -0.115 to the forward-stop aft face -0.1002 (14.8 mm: nose block, 3 mm stop) + XPS F-250 crush block >= 24.3 mm + 1.5 mm PETG spreader = 40.6 mm
nodes.basis: subsystems/pod/params.json fwd_stop_x_m -0.1002 (D2-R3, D-25); crush block C5 CR-C5-02, spreader_t_m 0.0015

nodes.title: Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; margin(pack m) = gate - (predicted - m_pack,carried + m) ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; fwd_room = (x_pack - L_pack/2) - x_pod_le - nose_stack ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group ; trim(pack m) = slide that brings x_cg(m) into range

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG
